title: CCX / MySQL & MariaDB
description: CCX MySQL / MariaDB datastores (replication and Galera) discovered via cmon service discovery.

links.title: Node Exporter
links.tooltip: Host metrics (pick the node there, or click a series here)

list.name: datastore
list.label: Datastore
list.description: Pick by datastore name; the value used in queries is the CCX datastore UUID (ClusterName).

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per database node: exporter status, role (from read_only), server version and uptime; click the IP for host metrics.

targets.expr: max by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job, version) (mysql_version_info{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Nodes up
panels.description: Number of MySQL/MariaDB exporters reporting the server as reachable, out of the nodes selected.

panels.title: Up per node
panels.description: 1 when the exporter can reach the server, 0 when it cannot.

panels.title: Queries per second
panels.description: Statements per second sent by clients (Questions counter), per node.

panels.title: Threads running
panels.description: Threads actively executing a statement right now; sustained high values indicate contention.

panels.title: Connections used vs max_connections
panels.description: Connected threads as a fraction of max_connections; approaching 100% means new clients will be refused.

targets.expr: max by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_global_status_threads_connected{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}) / on (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) clamp_min(max by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_global_variables_max_connections{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}), 1)

panels.title: Connected threads
panels.description: Currently open client connections and the peak since the server started.

panels.title: Role per node
panels.description: PRIMARY when read_only=0 (accepts writes), REPLICA when read_only=1; in Galera all writable nodes show PRIMARY.

panels.title: Replication lag
panels.description: Seconds the replica's SQL thread is behind its source (MariaDB Seconds_Behind_Master / MySQL 8 Seconds_Behind_Source); only replicas report it.

targets.expr: max by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_slave_status_seconds_behind_master{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"} or mysql_slave_status_seconds_behind_source{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Replica IO thread
panels.description: Whether the replica's IO thread (fetching binlog from the source) is running.

targets.expr: min by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_slave_status_slave_io_running{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"} or mysql_slave_status_replica_io_running{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Replica SQL thread
panels.description: Whether the replica's SQL thread (applying relay log) is running.

targets.expr: min by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_slave_status_slave_sql_running{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"} or mysql_slave_status_replica_sql_running{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Last replication errno
panels.description: Highest of the last IO / SQL replication error numbers per replica; 0 means no error.

panels.title: GTID position (MariaDB)
panels.description: MariaDB GTID sequence received (IO) and applied (SQL) by each replica; a growing gap means relay log backlog. MySQL 8 replicas do not export a numeric GTID.

panels.title: Relay log space
panels.description: Total size of relay log files on each replica; growth means the SQL thread is not keeping up.

panels.title: Cluster size
panels.description: Number of nodes in the Galera cluster component as seen by each node. Galera datastores only; empty for replication datastores.

panels.title: Cluster status
panels.description: Galera component status per node: Primary is healthy; Non-Primary or Disconnected (both exported as 0) means the node lost quorum or left the cluster. Galera datastores only; empty for replication datastores.

panels.title: Local state
panels.description: wsrep_local_state per node: 4=Synced is healthy; Joining/Donor/Joined mean the node is catching up or serving SST. Galera datastores only; empty for replication datastores.

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: wsrep_ready: whether the node accepts queries. Galera datastores only; empty for replication datastores.

panels.title: Flow control paused
panels.description: Fraction of time replication was paused by flow control since the last status flush; above a few percent the cluster is throttled by a slow node. Galera datastores only; empty for replication datastores.

panels.title: Receive / send queue
panels.description: Write-sets waiting to be applied (recv) or sent (send) on each node. Galera datastores only; empty for replication datastores.

panels.title: Flow control messages
panels.description: Flow-control pause messages sent and received per second; a node sending many is the bottleneck. Galera datastores only; empty for replication datastores.

panels.title: Top commands
panels.description: The ten most frequent command types per second across the selection (Com_* counters).

panels.title: Slow queries
panels.description: Statements per second exceeding long_query_time.

panels.title: Select types
panels.description: Rate of joins without indexes (full join), full table scans, range scans and range checks.

panels.title: Sorts
panels.description: Sort operations per second; merge passes indicate sort_buffer_size is too small.

panels.title: Temporary tables
panels.description: Temporary tables and files created per second, and the share of temp tables that spilled to disk.

panels.title: Network traffic
panels.description: Bytes per second received from and sent to clients.

panels.title: Buffer pool hit ratio
panels.description: Share of logical page reads served from the buffer pool rather than disk; below ~99% the pool is likely too small. No value while a node has no read requests (idle).

panels.title: Buffer pool pages
panels.description: Buffer pool pages by state (data, free, misc, old). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

panels.title: Dirty pages
panels.description: Modified pages not yet flushed to disk, as a share of data pages.

targets.expr: max by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_global_status_buffer_pool_dirty_pages{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}) / on (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) clamp_min(max by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_global_status_buffer_pool_pages{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance",state="data"}), 1)

panels.title: Row operations
panels.description: InnoDB rows read, inserted, updated and deleted per second; servers without Innodb_rows_* (MariaDB 11) fall back to all-engine handler counters, marked (handler). Shows the 10 series with the highest peak in the selected time range.

targets.expr: topk_max(10, sum by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job, operation) (rate(mysql_global_status_innodb_row_ops_total{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

topk_max(10, sum by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job, operation) (label_replace(rate(mysql_global_status_handlers_total{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance",handler=~"write|update|delete"}[$__rate_interval]), "operation", "$1", "handler", "(.*)") or label_replace(rate(mysql_global_status_rows_read{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "operation", "read", "", "")) unless on (instance) mysql_global_status_innodb_row_ops_total{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Row lock waits
panels.description: Row lock waits per second and the current number of transactions waiting on a row lock.

panels.title: Row lock time
panels.description: Milliseconds per second spent waiting for row locks (Innodb_row_lock_time is in ms).

panels.title: Data reads / writes
panels.description: InnoDB data file read and write operations per second, and fsyncs.

panels.title: Data read / written bytes
panels.description: Bytes per second read from and written to InnoDB data files.

panels.title: Log waits and history list
panels.description: Waits for the redo log buffer to flush (should be 0; otherwise raise innodb_log_buffer_size) and the undo history list length (long-running transactions).

panels.title: Threads
panels.description: Client threads connected, running and cached.

panels.title: Aborted connections
panels.description: Failed connection attempts (bad credentials, handshake errors) and clients that disconnected without closing properly, per second.

panels.title: Connection errors by type
panels.description: Server-side connection errors per second by cause (max_connections, accept, internal, ...), summed over the selected nodes.

panels.title: Open tables vs table_open_cache
panels.description: Open tables as a fraction of table_open_cache; near 100% with many misses means the cache is too small.

targets.expr: max by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_global_status_open_tables{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}) / on (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) clamp_min(max by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_global_variables_table_open_cache{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}), 1)

panels.title: Table cache hits / misses
panels.description: Table open cache lookups per second: hits, misses and overflows, plus tables opened.

panels.title: Open files vs open_files_limit
panels.description: Files held open by the server as a fraction of open_files_limit.

targets.expr: max by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_global_status_open_files{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}) / on (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) clamp_min(max by (DatastoreName, instance, ip, job) (mysql_global_variables_open_files_limit{job=~"cmon-sd.*",environment=~"$environment",ClusterName=~"$datastore",instance=~"$instance"}), 1)
